newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks tumble 2.32 pct in jittery market.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks tumble 2.32 pct in jittery market.

text.p: Pakistani stocks took another beating on Tuesday amid fears of political unrest and possible tough new economic measures, dealers said.

The Karachi 100-share index slid 32.38 points, or 2.32 percent, to 1,365.11 amid 185 losers and 50 gainers in a turnover of 16 million, up from Monday's 11 million. Dealers said it was likely to open lower on Wednesday.
"Rumours dampened market sentiment and investors retreated to the sidelines," dealer Majid Chapra said. "The market will remain bearish on Wednesday."
"The values of (telecom utility) PTCL and HUBCO (power plant) fell more than five percent, which shows GDR-linked stocks are the worst affected," dealer Asif Janmohammad said.
PTCL dived 1.85 rupees to 31.65, HUBCO dropped 1.70 to 29.25, Fauji Fertilizer fell 1.35 to 68.25, Dewan Salman shed 1.60 to 22.80 and Pakistan State Oil lost 3.00 to 332.
